calibration: one-vs-rest isotonic on D_probcal (source only), renormalised (section 6)
hyperparameters: fixed architecture-appropriate settings, not a per-dataset macro-F1 grid, to bound compute on a 634k-row training partition; same deviation as nb12 (CIC-IDS2017) and nb16 (UGR16), logged in deviations.md
probs_contents: srcpool = D_probcal-calibrated probabilities on the source calibration pool; target = same on the full target pool; both in canonical class order, float32
